Citizens Urge Government to Engage with Students on Hunger Strike

A group of citizens, including academics and public figures, have written an open letter to Prime Minister Narendra Modi urging the government to engage in dialogue with students who are on a hunger strike in Delhi. The letter calls for an end to what they describe as a "callous disregard" for the students' concerns. The specific demands or reasons for the hunger strike are not detailed in the provided coverage.
